name: ai-agents-local
description: Local development marketplace for the RoiTeachme AI-agents course. Three plugins covering Pikud HaOref alerts (oref.org.il), Tzeva Adom alerts, and PDF→Markdown conversion.

plugins.name: pikud-alerts-suite
plugins.description: Pikud HaOref alert workflow — agent + skill + SessionStart hook + cross-plugin reports/ guardrail.

plugins.name: tzevaadom-alerts-suite
plugins.description: Tzeva Adom alert workflow — alternative alert source bundled identically to pikud-alerts-suite.

plugins.name: markdown-suite
plugins.description: PDF → Markdown conversion plugin with SessionStart conversion-queue notification.

plugins.name: word-to-pdf-suite
plugins.description: Word (.doc/.docx) to PDF batch converter — skill that drives LibreOffice headless (with pandoc fallback) over to-convert-word-files/.
